basic_details.short_information: Inland Waterways Authority of India (IWAI) has notified 1 vacancy for the Director post on deputation. Candidates applying for the Director post must hold a Degree in Civil/Mechanical/Marine Engineering/Naval Architecture, with the age limit specified as not exceeding 56 years as on the closing date of application. The post carries Level 12 in the pay matrix as per 7th CPC. Eligible applicants must submit their offline application in the prescribed proforma through proper channel, attaching self-attested copies of certificates and the last 5 years APARs, sent through Registered Post or Speed P

content_sections.heading: About IWAI Director
content_sections.text: The Inland Waterways Authority of India operates under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, Government of India, with its head office located at A-13, Sector-1, Noida-201 301 (U.P.). It regulates and develops national waterways for shipping and navigation across the country.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Officers in the Central / State Government/ Statutory or Autonomous bodies/ Public Sector Undertakings meeting the following conditions: Holding analogous post OR 5 years regular service in Level 11 in the pay matrix (Pre-revised PB-3, Rs. 15600-39100 + GP Rs. 6600) and Degree in Civil/Mechanical/Marine Engineering/Naval Architecture from a recognized University/ Institute. Experience in works connected with inland waterways in dredging, river conservancy works, river training, marking of fairway rules and regulations for safety of shipping and navigation. content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The post carries Level 12 in the pay matrix as per 7th CPC. The Authority follows Central Government Rules & Regulations in service matters. Leased accommodation and medical reimbursement are provided as per the rules of the Authority. The period of deputation shall not ordinarily exceed 3 years. The post carries all India transfer liability at IWAI offices.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IWAI Director
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed proforma from the official IWAI website. Fill out the application form in Hindi or English, duly signed, and affix a self-attested photograph. Attach self-attested copies of certificates of educational qualifications, experience, and other relevant documents. Ensure the application is routed through proper channel if working in Central/State Governments/UTs/PSUs/Statutory or Autonomous Bodies. Enclose attested photocopies of complete and up-to-date ACR/APAR dossiers for the last five years (from 2020-2021 onwards) along with Vigilance Clearance and Integrity Certificate. Send an advance copy if delay is anticipated through proper channel before the closing date. Mail the complete application in a closed envelope superscribed "Application for the post of Director on deputation basis, against Employment Notice No. IWAI-12013/2/2024-ADMIN RECTT-Part(1) Dated 22.09.2026" to the Assistant Secretary (Admn. & Estt.), Inland Waterways Authority of India, A-13, Sector-1, Noida-201 301 (U.P.). Submit the application through Registered Post / Speed Post only within 45 days of publication in Employment News (about 6 November 2026).

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for the Director post is conducted on a deputation basis. The decision of the Authority as to the eligibility of a candidate shall be final, and the Curriculum Vitae will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Mere possession of essential qualifications will not entitle a candidate to be selected for the post. Canvassing in any form shall be ground for disqualification. Incomplete applications or applications received after the due date or not received through proper channel are liable to be rejected. The Authority follows Central Govt. Rules & Regulations in service matters. The post carries all India transfer liability.
